package.name: ssl_wheel_tracker
package.description: Wheel detection and tracking for the sensitive surface layer (SSL), a pressure-sensitive mat in the road surface. Detects wheel contacts as local pressure maxima in the pressure grids of one or more mats and tracks them with constant velocity Kalman filters, global nearest neighbour association and multi-hit track confirmation. Provides a ROS-independent core library and the ROS 2 component ssl_wheel_tracker::SslWheelTrackerNode. Replaces the Python packages ssl_wheel_detection and ssl_wheel_tracking.
package.author: Hendrik Steidl
